mapper.select: SELECT id,name FROM kb_kp WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM kb_kp WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT k.* FROM kb_kp k
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND subject=#{subject} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_kp_edge e WHERE e.to_kp_id=k.id AND e.kind='NEST') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_kp_edge e WHERE e.to_kp_id=k.id AND e.kind='NEST' AND e.from_kp_id=#{parentId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_kp_outline b WHERE b.kp_id=k.id AND b.outline_id=#{outlineId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_outline_node_kp b WHERE b.kp_id=k.id AND b.node_id=#{outlineNodeId})
ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_kp SET name=#{name},description=#{description},subject=#{subject},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_kp ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT from_kp_id AS fromKpId,to_kp_id AS toKpId,kind FROM kb_kp_edge
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_kp_edge WHERE from_kp_id=#{fromKpId} AND to_kp_id=#{toKpId} AND kind=#{kind}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_kp SET row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT question_id AS questionId,kp_id AS kpId FROM kb_question_kp

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_kp_edge WHERE to_kp_id=#{id} OR from_kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_kp WHERE kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_outline_node_kp WHERE kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_material WHERE kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_source_kp WHERE kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_kp WHERE kp_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_render_job j, JSON_TABLE(j.config_snapshot_json, '$.productCatalog.declaredKpIds[*]' COLUMNS(kp_id BIGINT PATH '$')) r WHERE r.kp_id=#{id})
SELECT outline_id FROM kb_kp_outline WHERE kp_id=#{id} ORDER BY outline_id

SELECT o.id AS outlineId,o.title AS outlineTitle,o.subject,o.textbook_version AS textbookVersion, o.grade,o.term,o.edition,n.id AS nodeId,n.title AS nodeTitle FROM kb_kp_outline b JOIN kb_outline o ON o.id=b.outline_id LEFT JOIN (kb_outline_node_kp nk JOIN kb_outline_node n ON n.id=nk.node_id) ON nk.kp_id=b.kp_id AND n.outline_id=b.outline_id WHERE b.kp_id=#{id} ORDER BY o.id,n.sort_order,n.id

SELECT b.kp_id,b.outline_id,o.id AS binding_outline_id,o.title AS outline_title,o.subject, o.textbook_version,o.grade,o.term,o.edition,n.id AS node_id,n.title AS node_title FROM kb_kp_outline b LEFT JOIN kb_outline o ON o.id=b.outline_id LEFT JOIN (kb_outline_node_kp nk JOIN kb_outline_node n ON n.id=nk.node_id) ON nk.kp_id=b.kp_id AND n.outline_id=b.outline_id WHERE b.kp_id IN #{id} ORDER BY b.kp_id,b.outline_id,n.sort_order,n.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_kp_outline WHERE kp_id=#{kpId} AND outline_id=#{outlineId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_outline_node_kp nk JOIN kb_outline_node n ON n.id=nk.node_id WHERE nk.kp_id=#{kpId} AND n.outline_id=#{outlineId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_kp_outline WHERE outline_id=#{outlineId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qk.question_id WHERE qk.kp_id=#{kpId} AND q.subject IS NOT NULL AND q.subject!='' AND q.subject!=#{subject}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_source_kp k JOIN kb_source_profile p ON p.source_id=k.source_id WHERE k.kp_id=#{kpId} AND p.subject != #{subject}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_kp k JOIN kb_product_profile p ON p.product_id=k.product_id WHERE k.kp_id=#{kpId} AND p.subject != #{subject})
